title: Restart the encoded forward and inverse balanced CRT endpoints on one 79-role inventory with paid reentry and retained history
body:
## Exact scoped result
Complete forward/inverse CRT calls reuse 79 physical roles across changing geometry, charging reentry and historical backing. Independent modular-inverse and lifecycle checks passed. Credits #7351 and #7352.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/30ae49d57441e9f1ffa7233f8f64729988a2fca1/research/encoded-crt-restart
